now-next-later.why: Explicitly organized into Now / Next / Later horizons with clear labels and no Gantt chart or fixed dates.

outcome-anchored.why: Every item in all three horizons is framed as an outcome or problem statement with specific metrics called out (D30 retention, WAU, notes per session, sharing events, etc.).

laddered-to-strategy.why: Strategy section explicitly states 'win with students' and all items are justified against student jobs-to-be-done (capture, retain, produce). Non-student items (calendar, templates) are deferred to Later with explicit rationale.

confidence-convention.why: Explicitly labels Now as 'high confidence,' Next as 'medium confidence,' Later as 'low confidence / not a commitment.' The 'How to read this' section reinforces that outcomes are committed but solutions evolve and Later items are directional signals.

now-focused.why: Now contains only two items with explicit rationale for keeping the list short. The bulk of the backlog is distributed across Next and Later.
